question: Who was the Minister of External Affairs as of January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr Subrahmanyam Jaishankar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The present Minister of External Affairs is **Subrahmanyam Jaishankar.**
 
• **Subrahmanyam Jaishankar** is an Indian diplomat and politician working as the **Minister of External Affairs of the Government of India since 30 May 2019.**
 
• He is a part of the **Upper House (Rajya Sabha) of India’s Parliament from the state of Gujarat.**
 
• Dr S. Jaishankar is a degree holder of** St. Stephen’s College at the University of Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Piyush Vedprakash Goyal **is a cabinet minister of the Government of India having portfolios like as **Minister of Textiles, Minister of Commerce and Industry and Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution. ​ **
 
• **Bhanu Pratap Singh Verma** is a Minister of State in the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium programs in the Government Of India.
 
• **John Barla** was elected to the Lok Sabha, the lower house of the Parliament of India from **Alipurduars, West Bengal in the 2019** Indian general election as a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party. **
